description: This file defines the InputOrganizationsEventTypesService class, which handles creation and updating of team event types, including validation, transformation, and managing related data such as hosts, locations, and email settings within an event management system.

classes.name: InputOrganizationsEventTypesService
classes.description: Service class for handling creation and update of team event types, including validation, transformation, and related data management.

methods.name: transformAndValidateCreateTeamEventTypeInput
methods.description: Validates and transforms input data for creating a team event type.

methods.name: transformAndValidateUpdateTeamEventTypeInput
methods.description: Validates and transforms input data for updating a team event type.

methods.name: validateTeamEventTypeSlug
methods.description: Checks if a team event type with the same slug already exists for the team.

methods.name: transformInputCreateTeamEventType
methods.description: Transforms raw input into internal format for creating a team event type, including handling email settings and children for managed types.

methods.name: transformInputCreateTeamEventTypeHosts
methods.description: Transforms host input data for creating a team event type, considering scheduling type.

methods.name: addEmailSettingsToMetadata
methods.description: Adds email settings to event type metadata.

methods.name: transformInputUpdateTeamEventType
methods.description: Transforms input data for updating a team event type, including handling hosts and metadata.

methods.name: transformInputUpdateTeamEventTypeHosts
methods.description: Transforms host data for updating a team event type, considering scheduling type and validation.

methods.name: getChildEventTypesForManagedEventTypeUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves child event types for a managed event type during update.

methods.name: getOwnersIdsForManagedEventTypeUpdate
methods.description: Gets owner IDs for a managed event type during update, based on assignment or hosts.

methods.name: getOwnersForManagedEventType
methods.description: Retrieves user details for given user IDs, excluding managed event types.

methods.name: getAllTeamMembers
methods.description: Returns all team members with fixed or variable assignment based on scheduling type.

methods.name: transformInputHosts
methods.description: Transforms host input data into internal format, setting priority and fixed status.

methods.name: validateHosts
methods.description: Validates that specified hosts are members of the team.

methods.name: validateInputLocations
methods.description: Validates that location integrations are valid and connected.

methods.name: checkAppIsValidAndConnected
methods.description: Checks if a conferencing app is valid and connected for the team.
